question: Which of the following is NOT a political party?
solution:
The correct answer is, **'Bharatiya Kisan Union**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatiya Kisan Union** was founded by **Dattopant Thengadi in 1978**.

 
 
• Bharatiya Kisan Union's very first conference was held in Kota, Rajasthan.
 
• Bharatiya Kisan Union is **not a political organization**, this organization is for the farmers and by the farmers.
 
• Bharatiya Kisan Union is a registered organization.
 
• The **membership in this organization is valid for three years**.
 
• **Elections are held every three years for working committee posts** from the village level to the national level.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Union Muslim League** is a** political (state) party, based in Kerala**.

 
 
• Indian Union Muslim League was** founded on 10 March 1948** with its first council in Chennai (then Madras).
 
 
 
• **Naga People's Front **is a **political (regional) party in Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, and Nagaland**.
 
 
• Naga People's Front was **founded in 2002 by Neiphiu Rio.**
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha** is a** political (state) party in Jharkhand**.
 
 
• The party was **founded by Binod Bihari Mahato on 15 November 1972**.
